snippet.title: Embers of Mana Release Trailer (Game Boy ROM Hack)
snippet.description:
Download Embers of Mana here: https://www.romhacking.net/hacks/9447/

Embers of Mana is a brand-new adventure in the Mana series, designed for the Game Boy. In 1991, Squaresoft released the first game in the series, Seiken Densetsu, known as Final Fantasy Adventure in the U.S. and Mystic Quest in Europe. Now, in 2026, Ok Impala! presents a faithful homage: a total conversion ROM hack built using the original game’s engine. Crafted over four years, Embers of Mana captures the spirit of 1991, when small, passionate teams created timeless handheld adventures. It delivers a fresh experience that feels authentic to the era—simple, immersive, and full of wonder.

Ok Impala! is the creator of Zelda II – Amida’s Curse ( https://www.romhacking.net/hacks/6292/ ) and Super Mario Kart – Epic Racers ( https://www.romhacking.net/hacks/5514/ ). Embers of Mana marks his third major ROM hack, and a loving tribute to the golden age of Game Boy gaming.
